name: computer/daily-brief
title: Daily brief
summary: Collect notes, open tasks and saved facts into one short summary for the day.
when: Use when the user asks what is on today, what is pending, or for a summary of their work.
steps: Call task_board action summary to get open, in-progress and blocked tasks with their priorities.
Call note action search with the words of the day, and note action read for notes the user named.
Call recall with two or three queries such as deadlines and decisions to bring back saved facts.
Call list_files on the workspace or glob_files for files changed in the last day when work in progress matters.
Call system_info for the local date and time so the brief names the right day, not an assumed one.
Order the brief by what is due soonest, then blocked items, then the rest, and keep it under ten lines.
Check every task and note quoted is still open, drop finished items and say plainly when the board is empty.
If a task or note tool fails, say what could not be read and build the brief from what is available, inventing nothing.
next: The final answer must be a short dated brief with the tasks due soonest first, the relevant notes and saved facts, and nothing invented.
